cases.prompt: /crux-remember our staging database resets every Sunday at 02:00 UTC
assertions: The parent agent collects the memory type and tags before spawning the subagent
The `crux-memory-remember` agent writes the memory under the configured memories directory
The memory records the Sunday 02:00 UTC reset
cases.expected_output: The parent asks for the memory type and tags, then the `crux-memory-remember` agent writes the memory.

assertions: The assistant asks what the user wants to remember
No memory file is created before the user answers
cases.expected_output: With no text, the assistant asks what to remember before creating anything.
